rationale: S-0084-02 proposes a per-seed mechanism decomposition of cell 767 across 5 t0081 evaluation seeds (0-4) to find joint-pass-supporting seeds. t0088's Phase B re-evaluates cell 767 with seed 1000 at 16 directions producing NaP 0.875 / Nav1.6 0.125 / NMDA 0.000, consistent with t0084's 8-direction attribution at the same cell. Cell 767 is in cluster 2 of t0088's k=4 partition, with the same NaP-dominant attribution shared across all 4 clusters. The original per-seed scope of S-0084-02 (cell-767 single-cell variability across 5 seeds) is older than t0088's population-level mechanism attribution, which already establishes the NaP-dominant signature is robust across cluster representatives. Reprioritising from high to medium; not rejecting because per-seed variance characterisation is not strictly covered by t0088's population analysis.
